messages:
deploy-bot: [ALERT] canary deployment failing for service=infra-inference-canary, 5/5 pods crashlooping, healthcheck=false, rolling error rate > 40%
Maria L: seeing the same from dashboard. canary started ~10:12 UTC, errors spike at 10:14. cfg points to new-artifact signing flow.
Maria L: logs from one pod: ```
2026-03-15T10:14:21Z ERROR verifier: manifest signature verification failed: invalid-signature: key-id mismatch
2026-03-15T10:14:21Z WARN loader: falling back to unsigned-image path
2026-03-15T10:14:22Z ERROR runtime: startup failed: incompatible-manifest-version
```
Ajay P: ugh. we just flipped the repo signing key yesterday as part of key-rotation. did the CI pipeline push artifacts signed by the new key into prod?
Samira - infra: checking registry metadata now. quick one: our enforcement gate is config `enforce_manifest_signatures=true` in the promotion pipeline. if the runtime verifier expects the old key, mismatch happens.
Dena (oncall): impact check: canary prefix only, but rollout was 20% traffic for the service route, that's customer-facing inference. customer errors reported via SLO monitor: ~3% request failures since canary start. recommend immediate kill-switch and rollback.
Maria L: agreed. first step: flip feature flag that routes 20% to canary back to 0. flag key `routes.inference.canary_weight`.
Dena (oncall): doing it now -> `/api/flags/set routes.inference.canary_weight 0`
deploy-bot: executed flag update by Dena (oncall) at 10:16 UTC :thumbsup: new canary weight=0.
Ajay P: also need to stop the promotion pipeline from promoting these signed artifacts. Samira can we pause the promote job in CircleCI?
Samira - infra: pausing promotion pipeline job `promote-to-prod` now. Command: ```bash
ci pause-job --org=redwood --job=promote-to-prod --reason="manifest-signature-mismatch investigation"
```
Samira - infra: paused. also marking artifacts with tag `quarantine/2420001111` in registry so they won't be re-deployed.
Dena (oncall): rolling back the deployment to previous stable image sha: `sha256:8f3b2a...`. Using k8s rollout restart with pinned image. ```bash
kubectl set image deployment/infra-inference infra-inference=registry.redwood.corp/inference:sha256-8f3b2a -n prod
kubectl rollout status deployment/infra-inference -n prod
```
deploy-bot: rollback triggered by Dena (oncall). rollout in progress.
Maria L: while that finishes, we should disable strict verifier on canaries to prevent noisy alerts, but do NOT disable on stable prod yet. we can flip runtime flag `verifier.strict=false` for namespace `canary` only.
Samira - infra: applying runtime override on canary cluster: ```bash
kubectl patch cm verifier-config -n canary -p '{"data":{"strict":"false"}}' && kubectl rollout restart daemonset/verifier -n canary
```
Ajay P: long-term fix: reconcile signing keys between CI and verifier. sounds like CI used new key-id `key-2026-03-14` but verifier still trusts `key-2026-01-30`. I'll open PR to update verifier truststore and add automated key-rotation compatibility.
Dena (oncall): handoff note for next oncall (Ken R): 
- Incident: Canary rollout caused runtime manifest signature mismatch leading to crashloop.
- Mitigations done: feature flag routed canary weight -> 0, promotion pipeline paused, problematic artifacts quarantined, rollback to stable image initiated, verifier relaxed in canary only.
- Customer impact: ~3% errors for inference traffic during canary window; blackbox SLO alerts fired but no major data loss.
- Followups: verify CI signing key metadata, update verifier truststore, re-run artifact signing validation, re-run CI build with new key and test canary in staging only.
Ken R: ack receipt of handoff. I'll take postmortem and own follow-ups tomorrow. please add runbook link and any commands you ran.
Maria L: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/manifest-signature-mismatch. I'll paste the final commands we ran into the ticket.
Samira - infra: note: KMS rotation notice at 2026-03-14 22:00 UTC. linking infra ticket: https://redwood.internal/infra/tickets/IR-2026-314-kms-rotate
Dena (oncall): closing timeline here. last check: rollout completed and pods stable at 10:22 UTC. marking incident as mitigated. leaving follow-up tasks in #incidents and assigning to Ajay and Samira.
deploy-bot: incident state changed -> mitigated by Dena (oncall) at 10:22 UTC.
